objective: Select the next validation goal after closing the filelist materialized-template public-pack boundary.

decision.reason: The filelist-derived template now executes correctly after manual source-closure repair. The next useful gap is making the source-closure requirement explicit and reproducible so future filelist-facing templates fail early or include the needed dependency closure before non-dry-run execution.

candidate_review.name: filelist_source_closure_dependency_policy
candidate_review.reason: It addresses the actual weakness discovered during the first materialized-template execution: the generator accepted an incomplete source list that Verilator could not compile.

candidate_review.name: verilator_native_option_prototype_boundary
candidate_review.reason: Native Verilator integration should wait until the filelist dependency-closure contract is explicit.

candidate_review.name: automatic_shape_policy_calibration
candidate_review.reason: Shape optimization should not hide unresolved source-discovery assumptions.

candidate_review.name: larger_filelist_materialized_template_shape_breadth
candidate_review.reason: More shapes would broaden evidence but would not address why the first non-dry-run initially failed.

candidate_review.name: resident_execution_optimization
candidate_review.reason: Runtime optimization remains separate from filelist source-closure correctness.
